# Vendor Evaluation: Cloud Hosting

Evaluated three providers on 2026-03-15:

1. AWS - $12,000/mo, best reliability, complex pricing
2. GCP - $9,500/mo, good ML tools, moderate reliability
3. Azure - $11,000/mo, best enterprise integration, OK reliability

Recommendation: GCP for cost savings, AWS if reliability is top priority.

# Incident 2026-03-22

Duration: 47 minutes
Impact: Checkout flow returned 500 errors
Root cause: Redis cluster failover triggered by memory pressure
Fix: Increased Redis memory limits from 4GB to 8GB
Action items: Set up memory usage alerts, review cache eviction policy
